secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Supabase project URL (Settings → API → Project URL). Required for the app to boot.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase publishable/anon key (Settings → API → Project API keys → anon public). Required for the app to boot.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.description: Supabase service role key (Settings → API → Project API keys → service_role). Needed for the demo account seeding and the recurring-transaction cron; not required to render pages.

secrets.name: CRON_SECRET
secrets.description: Secret used to authenticate the daily recurring-transaction cron call (Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>). Only needed for the /api/recurring/generate endpoint.
